theme.title: Around the League
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Bars: other stars' famous Finals nights. How many points did LeBron James score in Game 7 of the 2013 Finals?
questions.context: 2013 NBA Finals · Game 7 · vs San Antonio
questions.note: 37 with 12 rebounds; his late jumper sealed Miami's repeat over San Antonio.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James led the Miami Heat with 37 points, including five 3-pointers, and grabbed 12 rebounds

funFacts.text: A short Tim Duncan miss and a missed tip helped Miami survive San Antonio's late rally in the decider.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Duncan, guarded by Shane Battier, missed a shot under the basket and a follow-up tip-in attempt

funFacts.text: LeBron's late jumper finally secured Miami's repeat championship as the Spurs tried to steal the decider.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James went on to hit a 17-foot jumper that secured the victory

funFacts.text: Shane Battier's outside shooting helped cover scoreless games from both Chris Bosh and Ray Allen.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Battier scored 18 points on six 3-pointers to offset scoreless nights by Bosh and Allen

questions.prompt: Jason Kidd's 2001–02 Nets improved by 26 wins. By how many wins did rookie David Robinson's 1989–90 Spurs improve?
questions.note: 35, from 21–61 to 56–26: the largest one-season turnaround in NBA history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs leaped to a record of 56–26 for a remarkable 35 game improvement

funFacts.text: Robinson won Rookie of the Year unanimously after transforming San Antonio's fortunes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he was unanimously named the NBA Rookie of the Year

funFacts.text: Even as an NBA star, Robinson arrived only after completing his initial Navy service.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Robinson was commissioned in the Naval Reserve and was required to serve only an initial active-duty obligation of two years

funFacts.text: His breakout was immortalized in a Sega game titled David Robinson's Supreme Court.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Sega produced a game featuring him entitled David Robinson's Supreme Court

questions.prompt: Golden State opened 2015–16 with 24 straight wins. Coach Steve Kerr, out with a back injury, missed how many games to start?
questions.note: 43 games; Luke Walton went 39–4 as interim coach, with the wins credited to Kerr.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr missed the first 43 regular season games because of a back injury.

funFacts.text: Assistant Luke Walton steered Golden State to a remarkable start while Steve Kerr recovered.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Assistant coach Luke Walton served as interim head coach during Kerr's absence and he led the Warriors to a 39–4 start

funFacts.text: Golden State opened the season with 24 consecutive wins.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: best start to a season (24–0)

funFacts.text: Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson combined to average 52.2 points per game that regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: combining to average 52.2 points per game

questions.prompt: Bars: other forwards' scoring seasons. What did David West average as Chris Paul's frontcourt partner on the 2007–08 Hornets?
questions.note: 20.6 with 8.9 rebounds, earning his first All-Star selection.

funFacts.text: He made eighty-five percent of his foul shots.
West scored thirty in the first second-round victory over San Antonio.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 3 San Antonio 101–82 West (30)

questions.prompt: In Michael Jordan's famous 1992 Finals 'shrug' game against Portland, how many points did he score before halftime?
questions.context: Michael Jordan · Bulls vs Trail Blazers · 1992 Finals
questions.note: 35 first-half points, with a barrage of threes that led to Jordan's iconic shrug.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan had 35, Baylor had 33

funFacts.text: Jordan sank six threes before halftime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: six first-half threes (also a record)

funFacts.text: He famously shrugged toward the broadcast table.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: famously shrugged

funFacts.text: Chicago won Game 1 by a wide margin.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 122–89 win over the Portland Trail Blazers
